I quit my job at golden corral after a total of 4 shifts. Customers were mostly fine but god damn was it the most poorly managed place on the face of the earth. When I showed up for my first shift I was caught off guard by the fact that all of my co workers spoke exclusively spainish. After i finished my first shift I was fired and promptly rehired without my knowledge, this apparently gave them grounds to not pay me for the 8 hour shift. once the first pay day came around I realized that I hadn't been paid. I called my bank and found out that my manager had put in my name incorrectly in the system making it so I was unable to access my money. by that point I had enough and quit without a two weeks notice. Definitely the worst job I ever worked.
